title: Dual-currency sale, end to end
intent: Ring a real sale with both a LL-priced and a USD-priced product, pay with an overpayment so change is calculated, and check every money figure on every screen it appears on.
steps: Reset storage, sign in as owner, load /pos
Set a quantity above 1 on one line
Note the per-line prices and the cart total, in BOTH currencies
Compare the checkout totals against the cart totals
Pay with more than the total so change is produced
Complete the sale and read the receipt/summary
Open /transactions and compare the recorded sale to what was charged
checks: Cart total is a multiple of 5000
Cart total is NOT the sum of individually rounded lines
USD shown for the charge uses SELL_RATE 90000
The same product shows the same USD value on POS, checkout, receipt and history
Every request carries a store_id filter and no foreign store_id comes back
No uncaught console errors across the whole flow
